analogy.rationale: Myorelaxants act on skeletal muscle or central pathways that are minimally represented in these cell lines, so transcriptional responses should be weak; the closest reference classes are muscle relaxant and ion-channel blockers that can share downstream calcium/sodium signaling effects.
